awards.label: Best Overall
awards.why: A clean Matter over Thread on/off switch with 3-way support and no cloud account.

awards.label: Best Budget
awards.why: Under $35 and no wiring at all. It mounts over your existing switch and flips it.

awards.label: Best for No-Neutral Boxes
awards.why: Installs with or without a neutral and handles 3-way.

awards.label: Best Thread Dimmer
awards.why: No-neutral capable dimmer with forward and reverse phase dimming and adjustable brightness limits.

products.verdict: The most straightforward Thread switch. It's local-only with no Eve account, and it handles 3-way by replacing one switch.
pros: Matter over Thread with no Eve cloud, registration, or tracking
Single-pole or 3-way by replacing one switch
Works with Apple, Google, Amazon, and SmartThings hubs

products.verdict: Thread or Zigbee, neutral or no neutral, single-pole or 3-way. The most flexible on/off switch on this list.
pros: Works with or without a neutral
Matter over Thread, or Zigbee with an Aqara hub
Extra button works as a wireless scene switch
cons: Two-button layout looks different from a standard paddle

products.verdict: A Thread dimmer that works without a neutral and lets you set brightness limits to stop LED flicker.
pros: Works with or without a neutral
Forward and reverse phase dimming for a wide range of bulbs
Set minimum and maximum brightness to prevent flicker

products.verdict: Eve's Thread dimmer with flicker-free dimming and a touch-and-rocker design. Reviews are mixed.
pros: Precise, flicker-free dimming per the listing
Motion and presence automations through your platform
cons: Needs a neutral and a Thread border router

products.verdict: A no-wiring option for renters. It mounts over your existing toggle or rocker and flips it over Thread.
pros: Fits toggle or rocker switches, including multi-gang plates
Works with Apple Home, Google, SmartThings, and Home Assistant
cons: Runs on 2 AAA batteries, rated for up to a year
Sits on top of the switch instead of replacing it

avoid.flag: Discontinued brand, Apple Home only, 2.9 stars
avoid.verdict: Belkin has wound down the Wemo brand, so this switch won't get new features. It's Apple Home only and has the lowest rating of any Thread switch we found.
reasons: Belkin ended support for Wemo products on January 31, 2026. This Thread model still works inside Apple Home, but there's no Wemo app or future development behind it.
It only works with Apple HomeKit, per the listing title.
It's sold by a reseller with limited stock, and the spec table lists a 200 milliamp current rating.
